nodes.text: 觀塘綫Q車同港島綫M車PLARAIL套裝登場 New MTR PLARAIL Sets - The Kwun Tong Line Q Train & Island Line M Train Sets

全新港鐵PLARAIL系列，作為鐵路迷點可以錯過！ - 全球首推按照港鐵路綫圖顏色設計嘅路軌而非單調嘅藍色路軌 - 小朋友可以透過套裝發揮創意玩樂，亦可以認識港鐵唔同路綫、列車同車站 - 除咗兩個套裝可以組合一齊玩，亦兼容其它PLARAIL套裝 嚟緊會推出更多唔同彩色路軌嘅港鐵路綫PLARAIL套裝，各位鐵路迷敬請期待！ 港鐵PLARAIL套裝 款式：🟢觀塘綫Q車、🔵港島綫M車 推廣期：即日起至10月8日 售賣地點：MTR e-Store（網上及門市） 售價：每件港幣549元 MTR Mobile 會員網上優惠 • 單件優惠價：港幣490元 / 款（原價港幣549元/ 款）及免運費 • 組合優惠價：觀塘綫Q車+港島綫M車套裝港幣950元/ 套（原價港幣1,098元/ 套），首200名顧客即可獲贈PLARAIL入門套裝一盒（價值港幣 159元/ 款），送完即止 加購優惠：購買任何全新港鐵PLARAIL套裝即可以5折加購PLARAIL動感號或屯馬綫高級套裝（原價港幣549元/ 款） 即日起可以上MTR e-Store 及門市購買，即睇詳情🔗bit.ly/4pwxfek 圖片只供參考，數量有限，售完即止。 The brand new MTR PLARAIL series is a must-have for railway enthusiasts! For the first time, Takara Tomy has created PLARAIL track parts in the colours of MTR lines as shown on the MTR system map, moving away from the traditional monotone blue tracks. - In addition to freely constructing different track layouts, kids can learn about various MTR lines, trains, and stations. - The two sets can be connected and are also compatible with other PLARAIL sets and parts. More MTR x PLARAIL sets boasting colourful train tracks will be launched. Stay tuned MTR PLARAIL Set Version: 🟢Kwun Tong Line Q Train, 🔵Island Line M Train Promotion Period: Now - 8 October 2025 Sales Location: MTR e-Store (online and physical shops) Price: HK$549 each MTR Mobile Members Online Exclusive Offer*: •Promotional Price: HK$490 each (Original Price: HK$549 each) and FREE Delivery •Bundle Price: HK$950 / two sets (Original Price: HK$1,098 / two sets), the first 200 customers will receive a FREE PLARAIL Basic Starter Set (Original Price: HK$159/ each) while stocks last. Add-On Promotion Purchase any brand-new MTR PLARAIL set and you can enjoy 50% discount for PLARAIL Vibrant Express Deluxe or PLARAIL Tuen Ma Line Deluxe Set (Original Price: HK$549/ set) In-Store Exclusive Offer Purchase any brand-new MTR PLARAIL set at the MTR e-Store (Hong Kong West Kowloon or Admiralty stations), and the first 100 customers will receive a FREE PLARAIL Basic Starter Set (Original Price: HK$159/ each) while stocks last. Get these collectibles now at MTR e-Store and physical stores! Details🔗 bit.ly/4pwxfek Images are for reference only. Stocks are limited and available on a first-come, first-served basis. #港鐵網上商店 #港鐵PLARAIL #MTReStore #MTRxPLARAILSET #TAKARATOMY
港鐵聯乘PLARAIL全新系列登場啦！
全新觀塘綫Q車套裝包括咗首次登場嘅Q車。
全球首創！路軌顏色印足港鐵路綫圖，係觀塘綫專用嘅綠色。
套裝有觀塘站同黃埔站場景。
而港島綫M車套裝有堅尼地城站同杏花邨站場景。
路軌顏色都係港島綫專用嘅藍色嚟㗎。
仲可以同其他港鐵PLARAIL一齊玩。
快啲買嚟豐富你嘅鐵路板圖啦！
全新系列 港鐵 PLARAIL
全球首創！港鐵路綫圖顏色路軌！
全新系列 港鐵 PLARAIL
所有產品特意列示，套裝不包括TOMICA車仔、額外車卡、路軌及配件。
MTR and PLARAIL have launched a new toy train series featuring the Kwun Tong Line (Q-Train) and Island Line (M-Train) with color-matched tracks and iconic station scenes.
Encouraging customers to purchase the new sets to expand their toy railway collection.
Customers, especially train enthusiasts and children, can enjoy realistic MTR-themed toy train sets with line-specific colored tracks and familiar station settings.
